context.content_translation:
建造朱尼伯高塔的成本超过了承包商最初_______的金额超过了5,000.00英镑。
A. estimating
B. estimate
C. estimated
D. estimator 11

items.question: The cost of building Juniper High Towers exceeded the contractor’s original ------- by over £5,000.00.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“estimate”代入题干后为“The cost of building Juniper High Towers exceeded the contractor’s original estimate by over £5,000.00.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（estimate）。
